description: alr_001: invalid rules and the diagnostic codes (in source order) they must produce; a rule with errors does not compile and cannot be enabled.

cases.name: unknown severity
cases.rule: alert bad when true -> slack() severity = high

cases.name: unknown action argument
cases.rule: alert bad when true -> slack("x", priority = High)

cases.name: time plus time
cases.rule: alert bad when change.at + event.occurred_at > 1h -> slack()

cases.name: logical on string
cases.rule: alert bad when entity.name && true -> slack()

cases.name: pattern not literal
cases.rule: alert bad when entity.name matches entity.key -> slack()

cases.name: group_by not scalar
cases.rule: alert bad when true -> slack() group_by change.patch

cases.name: severity conflict
cases.rule: alert bad when true -> slack("x", severity = High) severity = Low

cases.name: invalid regex
cases.rule: alert bad when entity.name matches "(" -> slack()

cases.name: regex too large
cases.rule: alert bad when entity.name matches "x{{1000}}y{{1000}}z{{1000}}w{{1000}}v{{1000}}" -> slack()

cases.name: zero throttle
cases.rule: alert bad when true -> slack() throttle 0s

cases.name: bad quiet hours
cases.rule: alert bad when true -> slack() quiet_hours "25:00-07:00 UTC"

cases.name: empty quiet hours
cases.rule: alert bad when true -> slack() quiet_hours "22:00-22:00"

cases.name: unknown zone
cases.rule: alert bad when true -> slack() quiet_hours "22:00-07:00 Mars/Olympus_Mons"

cases.name: duplicate clause
cases.rule: alert bad when true -> slack() throttle 1h throttle 2h

cases.name: throttle without unit
cases.rule: alert bad when true -> slack() throttle 5

cases.name: non associative equality
cases.rule: alert bad when true == true == true -> slack()

cases.name: unterminated comment
cases.rule: alert bad when true -> slack() /* open

cases.name: trailing junk
cases.rule: alert bad when true -> slack() garbage

cases.name: several errors in source order
cases.rule: alert bad when foo.x == 1 && entity.nope -> pager() severity = Loud throttle 0s
